name: World Labs
summary: Spatial intelligence startup building models that understand and generate 3D worlds.
overview: World Labs is developing AI systems for spatial reasoning and world models.
bull_case: Spatial models could unlock new interfaces for robotics, simulation, and media.
bear_case: The technical path to reliable world models remains unproven and expensive.

intelligence.description: World Labs is building spatial-intelligence models that can understand, generate and interact with 3D worlds.
company: Founded by AI researcher Fei-Fei Li and collaborators, World Labs focuses on world models: systems that can reason about three-dimensional physical environments.
The company emerged from stealth in 2024 and has positioned its technology for 3D content, simulation, design and robotics workflows.
intelligence.why_it_matters: World models are a potential bridge between generative AI and physical-world applications. World Labs is a leading private bet on that transition, but commercialization remains early.

changed.text: Launched with $230M of funding and a reported $1B valuation.
Announced new funding to expand spatial-intelligence development and deployment.

takeaways: World Labs is a high-conviction bet on spatial AI rather than a conventional chatbot company.
The latest financing provides significant capacity to train and deploy models.
The valuation for the 2026 round was not publicly disclosed.
